categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of OLED organic materials. Products include OLED terminal materials (red, green, and blue light-emitting layer materials, hole transport layer materials, hole blocking layer materials, and electron transport layer materials) and OLED intermediates (deuterated and non-deuterated products). The company serves as a supplier to major OLED panel manufacturers including BOE, Tianma, Huaxing Optoelectronics, Heling Optoelectronics, and Xinyue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies spanning OLED intermediate synthesis, OLED sublimation precursor material preparation, OLED terminal material design, production, device fabrication, and evaluation. Key technologies include high-efficiency material development, high-purity material development, high film-forming capacity material development, quantum efficiency enhancement, mixed-type host carrier matching, and advanced synthesis methods such as one-pot boronic acid preparation, Danheiser benzene ring formation, and copper-catalyzed Ullman coupling reactions. The company employs vacuum evaporation deposition methods and maintains OLED device fabrication and testing platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are major OLED panel manufacturers including BOE (75.12% of 2023 sales), Tianma, Huaxing Optoelectronics, Heling Optoelectronics, and Xinyue. End-market applications include smartphones, televisions, tablets, computers, smart wearables, and automotive displays. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with 2023 domestic business revenue of 244.7 million yuan and overseas business revenue of 32.3 million yuan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production facilities in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province. The company has established subsidiaries including Lighte Maisi (Xi'an), Puyang Lighte, and Chenggu Lighte. The company serves customers globally, with international sales representing approximately 11.6% of total revenue in 2023. Products are protected by patents covering China, United States, Japan, South Korea, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the OLED supply chain. It functions as a midstream to downstream supplier, producing both OLED intermediates (upstream materials for terminal material synthesis) and OLED terminal materials (direct inputs for OLED panel production). The company maintains vertical integration with its own OLED sublimation factory and fine chemical synthesis factory, enabling control from intermediate synthesis through terminal material production to device evaluation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D innovation with a three-generation product development strategy: front-looking research, in-development products, and commercialized applications. Key R&D focuses include: (1) Red, green, and blue light-emitting host and dopant materials; (2) Next-generation products including Red Host, Green Prime, and blue phosphorescent materials; (3) Advanced technologies such as stacked device materials, TADF materials, and hyperfluorescent materials; (4) New business directions including perovskite materials and pharmaceutical intermediates. R&D investment increased 40.92% to 50.4 million yuan in 2023, representing 16.77% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of OLED organic materials to OLED panel manufacturers. The revenue model is product-based, with customers placing orders directly for OLED terminal materials and intermediates. The company employs a 'sales-driven production' model where production is planned based on customer orders and medium-term demand forecasts. Revenue is recognized upon product delivery to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic OLED terminal material supplier, competing primarily against international companies including UDC, DuPont, and Merck, which dominate the global market. Domestically, the company is among the few enterprises that have broken through foreign patent barriers and achieved mass production of OLED terminal materials. The company holds the position of national 'specialized and sophisticated' small giant enterprise and received the 2021 manufacturing 'single champion product' designation for its Red Prime material. The company maintains leading domestic market share in OLED terminal material production and shipment volume.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 300.7 million yuan (7.27% growth year-over-year) and net profit attributable to shareholders of 77.0 million yuan (26.95% decline year-over-year). Total assets reached 1.94 billion yuan as of year-end 2023, with net assets of 1.70 billion yuan. The company's gross margin on main business was 60.52% in 2023. The company has demonstrated strong growth since its 2022 IPO, with 2021 revenue of 341.2 million yuan, indicating cyclical market dynamics in the OLED industry.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) High-quality patented products with superior performance in efficiency, color purity, and device lifespan; (2) Comprehensive patent portfolio with 314 authorized patents covering core OLED functional layer materials; (3) Complete product-chain integration from intermediate synthesis to terminal material production and device evaluation; (4) Strong R&D capabilities with 101 R&D personnel (27.67% of workforce) and collaboration with leading universities; (5) Proven track record with Red Prime material recognized as manufacturing single champion product and Green Host material achieving first domestic mixed-type material substitution; (6) Comprehensive technical support and device evaluation services that enhance customer stickiness and enable rapid product iteration.
